canonical_name: Incident Recovery End Not Declared Based on Criteria
description: The end of incident recovery is not declared based on criteria.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations with business continuity and disaster recovery requirements Incident recovery and restoration teams Communications and public relations functions Organizations with regulatory recovery requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify incidents where recovery activities cease without formal closure declaration or documented completion criteria. Monitor for missing post-recovery documentation, lessons learned, or undefined exit criteria that leave recovery status ambiguous.
